items = []
cursor = None
while True:
    args = {'limit': 2}
    if cursor: args['cursor'] = cursor
    page = (await tools.nudge.list_issues(**args))['data']
    items.extend(page['items'] or [])
    cursor = page.get('nextCursor')
    if not cursor: break
return [x['identifier'] for x in items]
name: nudge: page all issues
